generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

As per Karnataka state Government order LD.300.LET.2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW.134.BMS.2007 dated 27.07.2007 a sum amounting to 1 Percent of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing works and other similar structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified on his own risk and cost.
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of eProcurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP Portal
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons
The contractors assessed available tender capacity shall be more than the tender value. It shall be calculated as per the standard tender document attached.
The Tender processing fee shall not be refundable
Tenderer who qualifies in the technical bid such tenderers financial bid will be opened
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, refectors,deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent
All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public/ private properties

As per Government circular no: FD 355 EXP 12/2024 dt: 01.08.2024 Letter of intent(LOI) will be issued in KPP Portal, The contractor has to accept LOI online and submit the SD through KPP portal within 20 days. Failing which, the tender is liable for rejection
The tender validity period is 90 Days from last date of receipt of Tenders
Estimate rates are excluding GST and paid separately.
The Defects Liability Period is ONE YEAR
